text.p: -- Robinson-Humphrey Co Inc said it downgraded SEACOR Holdings to short-term market perform from buy.
-- cited an announcement by Edison Chouest, a privately -held company, that it ordered 10 vessels with an option for an additional seven.
-- said sources indicate Edison Chouest could order 10 more vessels, as as well.
-- said "a doubling of potential new supply, without the apparent new projects to serve, increases the uncertainty of possible market saturation over several years."
-- said the new vessels should take more than two years to all reach the market.
-- said despite continued strong earnings growth near-term, additional uncertainty create by potential new vessel supply could act as a restraint on vessel stock prices near-term.
-- said as market absorbs Edison Chouest's announcement, there could be new energy development projects to absorb the new capacity and keep the market stable.
-- SEACOR operates marine vessel fleet, mainly supporting offshore oil and gas exploration and development in the U.S. Gulf of Mexico, North Sea and offshore west Africa.
